info.description: The Rideshare ETA Retrieval API provides real-time estimated time of arrival (ETA) data for rideshare services. This endpoint allows users to retrieve ETA information based on specific ride requests. Typical consumers include rideshare application developers and transportation services looking to enhance customer experience by providing accurate ride timing. The API streamlines the onboarding of rideshare features, ensuring users stay informed about their ride's expected arrival time.

get.summary: Retrieve estimated arrival time for rides.
get.description: This endpoint provides the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for rides based on the given location. It helps users plan their travels by providing timely information about when they can expect their ride to arrive.
